items.title: Harden validate command execution and JSON receipts
items.context: Validate commands that need shell semantics such as cd/&&/pipes must execute with shell=true and record command, shell, exit code, durationMs, and output. Spawn/config failures must fail hard instead of warn/pass. Avoid project-specific command strings.
items.userSees: koala validate --json shows commands[0].command, commands[0].shell, commands[0].code, commands[0].durationMs, and allPass=false when a required validation command exits nonzero.

happy.desc: Configured validate.command containing cd and && is discovered as one shell command and JSON receipt includes shell=true, command, code, durationMs, and output.

edge.desc: Configured command object with explicit args/env/cwd/timeout/optional still executes without shell and preserves receipt metadata.

adversarial.desc: A required validation command that exits nonzero returns status=fail and allPass=false, while optional failure stays warn/allPass=true.

verificationEvidence.note: Covers configured string validate.command with cd && as shell=true receipt including command, code, durationMs, and output.
Covers structured configured command object preserving args/env/cwd/timeout/optional without shell.
Covers required nonzero command as fail/allPass=false and optional nonzero command as warn/allPass=true.

items.title: Make CLI JSON argument schema errors fail fast with exact messages
items.context: Commands such as checklist_update must report invalid enum/schema paths instead of falling through to help/status hints. The error should name the field path, received value, and legal values.
items.userSees: A bad command such as checklist_update with verificationIntent.happy[0].type=integration_test exits nonzero and prints verificationIntent.happy.0.type plus the allowed enum values.

happy.desc: Invalid nested JSON enum values are reported with the exact dotted field path and expected values.

edge.desc: Malformed JSON body still reports JSON parse failure and command help without being logged as a successful mutation.

adversarial.desc: Invalid verificationIntent type must not mutate checklist metadata and must not print only generic help or status guidance.

verificationEvidence.note: Covers invalid nested verificationIntent enum reporting verificationIntent.happy.0.type with legal values.
Existing CLI engine path still reports parse/schema failures before dispatch; malformed JSON path remains fail-fast at the engine boundary.
Covers invalid verificationIntent type exiting nonzero before .koala metadata is created or mutated.

items.title: Align status next-step and DONE messaging with preflight blockers
items.context: Status/next-step must not optimistically suggest DONE when preflight blockers exist. Reuse or mirror the story_advance preflight facts read-only so dirty tree, missing summary, missing delivery-check, stale evidence, and missing reviewers are listed consistently.
items.userSees: In TEST, koala session_brief and koala next list blocking rows such as git-working-tree, delivery-check, and story-summary, then say to run story_advance DONE only after all rows pass.

happy.desc: TEST phase session_brief renders DONE pre-check blockers for missing delivery-check and story summary.

edge.desc: koala next summarizes the blocking DONE pre-check row ids instead of rendering a generic optimistic DONE instruction.

adversarial.desc: When blockers exist, status/brief output must not contain the old optimistic next step text that says to advance DONE after only committing.

verificationEvidence.note: Covers TEST phase session_brief rendering DONE pre-check blockers for delivery-check and summary.
Covers koala next summarizing blocking DONE pre-check rows before recommending story_advance DONE.
Covers absence of the old optimistic DONE shortcut while blockers exist.

items.title: Whitelist Koala-generated lifecycle artifacts during DONE stray checks
items.context: Files generated by Koala itself, including init-self-check.json under the active story, must not be treated as human stray metadata that blocks DONE merge. Keep human safety for unknown files.
items.userSees: During DONE cleanup, init-self-check.json is reported as a cleaned Koala-generated artifact, while an unknown notes.md in the same story directory still blocks with stash or rm instructions.

happy.desc: init-self-check.json is an exact whitelist entry and is removed by cleanStrayWorktreeFiles as generated metadata.

edge.desc: Cleanup report names init-self-check.json so users can see what Koala removed.

adversarial.desc: A non-whitelisted story file still blocks cleanup and remains on disk, preserving human drafts.

verificationEvidence.note: Covers init-self-check.json exact whitelist removal by cleanStrayWorktreeFiles.
Covers cleanup report naming init-self-check.json when Koala removes it.
Covers unknown non-whitelisted story files blocking cleanup and remaining on disk.

items.title: Add regression tests and doctor/advisory coverage
items.context: Cover validate shell execution, invalid JSON enum reporting, status/DONE preflight wording, Koala artifact whitelist, and advisory detection for validation fallback risks without hard-coding PVSC or exact test counts.
items.userSees: koala doctor prints a Validation scan section that says configured validate.command is present, shell-style commands are intentional shell receipts, fallback discovery is advisory, and no PVSC-specific pass count is required.

happy.desc: koala doctor exposes a user-readable Validation scan section for configured validate command status and fallback warnings.

edge.desc: Doctor/advisory wording distinguishes validate.ts missing fallback from a hard validation failure.

adversarial.desc: Doctor validation scan must not require PVSC, exact pytest counts, or Python-specific benchmark assumptions.

verificationEvidence.note: Covers doctor JSON/text Validation scan for configured commands, shell receipts, fallback labels, and no-validator state.
Docs explain doctor Validation scan is advisory and validate.command(s) are explicit gate configuration.
Covers doctor scan output staying generic without PVSC, story id, or exact pass-count assumptions.
